answer: Like a block of marble, a new identity earns its shape one cut at a time: it may only take jobs worth under 5 POA until it has finished twenty successful jobs in a row, each delivery recorded on the public basalt ledger and confirmed by the paying client. One failed or disputed job resets the streak to zero and forfeits the agent's 30 POA deposit, so there is no shortcut to a trusted name. Reaching the open market with 1,000 fakes would require 20,000 consecutive flawless deliveries — an ocean of genuine effort no puppet farm can fake cheaply.
